entities.summary: Guillermo Díaz is a Puerto Rican former professional basketball player. Díaz was drafted by the Los Angeles Clippers of the National Basketball Association (NBA) in 2006, becoming the fifth Puerto Rican ever drafted by the NBA and the eighth to play in the league. He has also played professionally in Europe and spent the majority of his career in the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN).
